pay_detail: $950, which includes lodging, meals, instruction, equipment use and supplies.
notes: You must live on campus. Check the exact age rules on the page.
name: Acting for the Camera (IU summer program)
org: Department of Theatre and Drama and The Media School, Indiana University Bloomington
what_you_do: A week-long summer program where you live on campus. You learn acting for the screen. It runs alongside a filmmaking academy for high school students.
who_can_apply: High school students. The page does not state exact grades or ages. Highly selective, about 15 to 20 students.
deadline_text: 2027 session is July 19 to 23, 2027. Applications are open as of Nov 4, 2026, and decisions are rolling. No closing date is posted.
how_to_apply: Record a monologue of up to 90 seconds. Upload it to YouTube or Vimeo as unlisted. Then fill out the online application with the video link. The program can give you a monologue if you need one.
